## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Normal only; second model and all 5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, Invasive <1% | Strongly peaked |
| Conformal set | {Normal}, α=0.10 | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.98 / 20th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↓ invasive · Largest benign association; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 6, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Second-largest benign association; spot check 20/20 · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Near typical; negligible contribution here · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Near typical; negligible contribution here · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect classifier use. Leans on Unreliable normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- A small tumor focus lies outside regions 3, 8, 11, the only nuclei-segmented ones (13 nuclei).
- Calibration is dataset-level on 132 images; ECE 0.05 (CI 0.03–0.18) leaves room for error.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 4**: look for infiltrating tumor or pleomorphism; highest scores for both concepts here.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 9**: confirm two-layered normal lobules yourself; the automated spot check failed.
3. **Regions 3, 8, 11**: examine epithelium for atypia; nuclei counts were too sparse to assess tumor.
